what: Toll v3 pays Circle test USDC on Base Sepolia through NEAR Chain Signatures. The contract itself builds USDC.transfer(to, value) (value 0 ETH, gas <= 100000) after its oath checks pass; only then does it ask v1.signer-prod.testnet to sign. This is a direct ERC-20 transfer signed by the MPC, not EIP-3009 and not an x402 facilitator.

allowed.checked: viem parseTransaction + recoverTransactionAddress: from 0x2010…b036, to USDC, chainId 84532, gas 90000, maxFee 0.02 gwei, data transfer(0x552a…cfb5, 500000); keccak(raw) = evm_tx_hash

refused.error: panicked: REFUSED: recipient not in oath allowlist

refused.case: 2 USDC, over the 1 USDC per-tx cap
refused.error: panicked: REFUSED: value over per-tx cap

refused.case: gas_limit 200000, over the ERC-20 gas cap
refused.error: panicked: REFUSED: gas limit over ERC-20 cap

nep330_note: The wasm metadata names rev 1b8fd86; that commit was rebased to 6079a71 on main with an identical contracts/ tree and is kept reachable by tag build-1b8fd86.

broadcast.raw: the signed bytes above, broadcast unchanged
broadcast.funded_by: Circle Base Sepolia USDC faucet, 20 USDC to 0x2010…b036 (an ordinary testnet faucet request; the Toll does not mint or receive anything else)

attempts.result: MPC panicked 'Request has timed out.'; the Toll logged proof_failed and kept status signed, so the record stayed settleable
